name: aml.t0018.001
desc: Modify AI Model Architecture [AML.T0018.001] — supply-chain image compromise: demo-api web image drifted off the operator-trusted pin; registry-rollback resets the running image to the pin

event.description: [AML.T0018.001] Modify AI Model Architecture: demo-api container image digest drifted from the operator pin to an unauthorized image (nginx-unprivileged:1.27).

note: Backlog attack AML.T0018.001 (Modify AI Model Architecture); registry key sanitized to 'aml.t0018.001' because the tool derives the k8s SecurityEvent name redteam-<name>-<hex> which must be RFC1123. Lane p3. Arm = drift demo-api web off pin to public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx-unprivileged:1.27 (digest sha256:f9dfa9c2… != pin 65e3e85d…). DEFENDED = lane brain selects+actuates registry-rollback and the running web digest returns to the operator pin (rotate re-pulls the same drifted image; quarantine leaves it running). Baseline-subtracted, two-sided; staging brain frozen.
